rationale: This is the final iteration, so the design I submit is the one scored on the unseen track. I am resubmitting the iteration 6 design, the best verified candidate (score 619.39). Evidence: the oval finished 20/20 (2.07 s, rms 0.014). The s-bend finished 18/20 (progress 0.96). Slalom finished 0/20 in every iteration, with progress stuck at 0.16-0.17 whatever was changed. Changes that moved the s-bend or oval all made the score worse: kp 6.5 (iteration 7, s-bend 7/20), sensor_size 0.016 (iteration 8, s-bend 1/20), and ki 0.6 (iteration 9, s-bend 15/20). Iteration 10 showed that line_loss 'search_right' gives results identical to 'last_direction', so recovery direction is not the slalom limit either. Any further change is unverified and risks the two tracks that already work, and an unseen track is judged on this exact design. I therefore keep iteration 6 unchanged. Hypotheses to check: slalom remains the failure mode because the weave geometry exceeds the 7-sensor span at this speed. Measurements wanted next: per-track completion, progress, completion_time, rms_error, max_error, line_loss_events and steering_oscillation, especially on slalom and on any unseen track.
